regions.merged_text: I do hope you all keep well and that this finds you in hope- ful outlook. After all the present is so passing and so quickly gone that in the sight of Heaven it must appear nothing more than momentary. Many thanks for your kind remembrance of January 15th under such "prorsus" unwanted circumstances. Also that of the day-before yesterday. May the dear Lord Himself be your Reward. I am applying this latter as an enrollment in the Seraphic Mass Association, of the Holy Souls inPurgatory; -- especially the deceased of St. Paul's little Maltese Parish on 4th Street as also the deceased and living- benefactors / to whom we are appealing these days for prayers and for material assistance. Among these latter, as I suggested several weeks back I have had in mind the model and saintly Monsignor Connolly and his eminent Brother the Judge, both of whose early deaths Detroit so much lamented. I had the privilege of meeting the former for sev- eral years and of helping-out in the church that / his proposition and what few know about, his prophecy of a new Cath.
